slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year, and is that output a fixed number per training jet or does it depend on other factors?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-jet annual pilot training capacity, which fully covers the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts; related timing questions addressed availability and jet reuse, not the training program start or duration.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both year 1 and year 2, with decision variables for training jets in each year.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed the training program's start year or duration, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary treats training allocations in year 1 and year 2 as confirmed decision variables.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot was not asked before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 training-capacity fact and clarified several operational details, but it stopped while the P1 training start/duration fact remained unconfirmed and silently assumed a two-year training timeline.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
